qs.q: What is the most common mechanism of supraventricular tachycardia in infants, characterized by a re-entrant tachycardia involving an accessory pathway?
qs.e: Atrio-ventricular reciprocating tachycardia (AVRT) is the most common mechanism of SVT in infants, operating via a re-entrant circuit with an accessory pathway. AVNRT is more commonly seen as a form of SVT in adolescents.

qs.q: A stable child with supraventricular tachycardia is brought to the emergency department. Which of the following is an appropriate non-pharmacological acute management measure?
o: Placing an ice bag over the face
qs.e: Placing an ice bag over the face, Valsalva maneuvers, straining, and breath-holding are non-pharmacological measures used for acute SVT management. Verapamil is contraindicated in infants under one year, and initial cardioversion dosing listed is 1 J/kg.
